proposals.evidence: Turner gives Prakrit vakkala and Hindi bakal/bakkal/baklā bark under valkala, with parallel Oriya bakaḷa and Assamese bakalā. Kathoriya bakala matches this a-vowel branch; o-vowel bokrā forms are assigned separately to *vōlkala.

assignments.Notes: Turner gives Prakrit vakkala and Hindi bakal/bakkal/baklā bark under valkala, with parallel Oriya bakaḷa and Assamese bakalā. Kathoriya bakala matches this a-vowel branch; o-vowel bokrā forms are assigned separately to *vōlkala. Autonomous remaining-survey review, 2026-09-21; no rebuild.

proposals.evidence: Turner’s onomatopoeic *kutta family includes Punjabi/Lahnda kuttā, West Pahari kuttā, Nepali kuti, Oriya kutā, Hindi kuttā and Gujarati kuttɔ. These whole survey dog forms fit that regional family, retaining the source’s dental/retroflex and occasional aspirated spellings as expressive variation rather than a claimed regular sound law. r-bearing and doubly aspirated responses are excluded.
